notes: 2026-08-29 (branch `fix/e2e-and-analytics-spec-absorb`, off master 0b2c3a0a) — ROOT-CAUSED AND FIXED THE CHRONIC MASTER E2E RED, plus absorbed 8 orphaned analytics spec cases. (1) THE E2E FIX: `E2E (Playwright)` had been red on master for weeks (0b2c3a0a, 5cb71545, 96826793, 28cb0a25, 424c7201) while all six other jobs passed — and it was NEVER an app problem (post-deploy-check + feature-smoke were green against production throughout). `apps/web/e2e/helpers/auth.ts` `fillWorkspaceIfShown` did `isVisible()`-then-`fill()`. `isVisible()` is a POINT-IN-TIME check with no auto-wait: the server-rendered login form shows the Workspace field for a frame before the client derives the tenant from the hostname and drops it, so `isVisible()` returned true, hydration removed the node, and the following `fill()` burned the full 20s `actionTimeout` and threw `TimeoutError: locator.fill … waiting for getByLabel('Workspace')`. Because EVERY role project `depends on` the `setup` project, that ONE failure failed the whole job — signature: operator FAILS outright while customer goes FLAKY on the identical code path (pure timing). Replaced with a single atomic `await page.getByLabel("Workspace").fill(slug, { timeout: 5_000 })` in a try/catch: `fill()` auto-waits so a field appearing mid-hydration is still handled, and one that never appears costs only the short timeout. ⚠️ NOT a vacuous green — if the workspace value were genuinely required, the `waitForURL("**/dashboard")` immediately after fails loudly. MEASURED against production: before = operator FAILED + customer flaky; after = operator ok 11.6s, customer ok 10.0s, super-admin skipped (its `PLAYWRIGHT_SA_*` secrets are absent — expected). ⚠️ RULED OUT, do not re-chase: `global.setup.ts` is well-behaved — with no `E2E_SEED_DATABASE_URL` in CI it logs and returns cleanly rather than throwing; the absent seed secret is BY DESIGN (CI targets the deployed app's standing `e2e-routeflow` tenant). ⚠️ You can reproduce E2E failures WITHOUT a public window — Actions logs are unreadable while the repo is private (`gh run view --log` ⇒ "log not found", and the `if: failure()` playwright-report artifact never uploads; only `coverage-reports` comes back). Instead: `cd apps/web && CI=true SKIP_E2E_SEED=true PLAYWRIGHT_BASE_URL=https://routeflowweb-production.up.railway.app PLAYWRIGHT_TENANT_SLUG=e2e-routeflow npx playwright test --project=setup`. `test-results/<test>/error-context.md` carries the full a11y page snapshot — that is what proved the Workspace field genuinely does not exist on that host. Start with `--project=setup`: everything depends on it. (2) THE SPEC ABSORPTION: the abandoned `focused-kalam` worktree held 8 test cases that existed NOWHERE in master. A branch audit had called it "superseded" because master's implementation is a strict SUPERSET (it adds on-time-rate/stops-per-hour/avg-duration) and master had MORE cases overall (43 vs 39) — but the case SETS were not nested. Ported onto master's real implementation: controller 5→7 cases, service 44→50. `analytics.controller.spec.ts` gained a "route/driver performance" block pinning that `getRoutes`/`getDrivers` forward from/to to BOTH service methods and forward absent params as `undefined` — the shipped from/to wiring had ZERO controller coverage until now, so its mock now stubs `getRoutePerformance`/`getDriverPerformance` alongside `getProductDemand`. ⚠️ LESSON: when judging whether a branch is superseded, diff the TEST-CASE TITLE SETS, not just the implementation — a higher total case count can still hide missing coverage. || History in CHANGELOG.md (this directory).
